name: Melantha
description: A priestess of Ephara and member of the high council who dreams of her old mentor Xenocrates, whom she saw poisoned.

timeline.summary: In a dream, Melantha dines with her dead mentor Xenocrates, who drinks wine from a poisoned goblet and coughs up blood as he voices blasphemous theories; she wakes screaming.
timeline.quote: I did not... I did not kill you, Xenocrates.

timeline.summary: Xenocrates argues that gods are the patterns mortals recognize, personified through the power of Nyx, and that mortals are responsible for their gods; Melantha forbids it as blasphemy.
timeline.quote: Through the power of Nyx, we are responsible for our gods.

relations.note: Xenocrates was one of her first mentors at Ephara's temple.
relations.quote: Xenocrates had been one of her first mentors at Ephara's temple

relations.note: Melantha is a priestess of Ephara's temple and on the high council.
relations.quote: to balance the demands of serving her god with finding acceptance among her peers
